questions: Verify ephemeral runs, exec resume/fork, required nullable fields and current sandbox flags.
Compare native compaction with short artifact handoffs using pinned CLI evidence.
decision: Separate Codex event-stream parsing from final-schema validation, retain explicit sandbox/approval contracts and make session reuse an opt-in same-provider operation.
code_observations: The Codex worker uses exec and ephemeral mode. The completion schema adapter makes optional fields required-nullable for the supported structured-output contract.
run_concise modifies the effective worker prompt and therefore requires composed-entrypoint tests, not only a raw argv golden.

symbols.name: ## Elevation mechanics (how a route is actually obtained)

implementation_steps: Record CLI version/help and model-discovery evidence without starting a paid task; select tested capability branches for exec, structured output and sandbox flags.
Maintain a schema transformation test for nested objects, required nullable fields, additionalProperties and invalid outputs. Refusal or incomplete output is not a passing task.
Keep ephemeral mode for normal cross-task isolation. Same-provider resume/fork is a separate opt-in contract, never a way to transfer private reasoning state to another provider.
Use read-only sandbox for observation/review where supported and verify that output/log paths can still be written only in owned locations.
Parse JSONL events incrementally and preserve the final report independently of progress text. Link deterministic validation evidence through the production prompt.
Parse bounded JSONL events independently from the final completion schema; reject truncated or missing terminal reports.
Bind optional session reuse to exact provider, repository and task identity; preserve ephemeral default.
Remove universal no-cache-write-cost assumptions from planned economics and use model-versioned reported usage.
proposed_acceptance_tests: Schema fixtures remain accepted by the adapter without weakening additionalProperties checks.
Ephemeral default argv and composed static prefix remain stable.
Malformed events, partial final JSON, a nonzero exit and a valid blocked report remain distinguishable.
An unsupported sandbox/effort flag fails preflight instead of falling back to unrestricted execution.
Cache and cost records distinguish reported usage from estimates and do not import outdated no-write-cost assumptions.
A successful progress event followed by malformed final JSON cannot complete a task.
A resume request cannot attach another repository session.
Sandbox mismatch is an environmental or policy block, not a model capability escalation.
Cache-write usage remains distinct from uncached input and cache reads.

previous_decision: Validate Codex as an ephemeral execution protocol with explicit schema and sandbox adaptation; do not infer supported flags from model names.
revision_delta: The revision corrects the stale assumption of universally free OpenAI cache writes and adds event-order, partial-output and session-binding failure cases.
decision_analysis: JSONL progress events are not the task completion document. A stream can contain tool starts, transient errors, usage and a terminal event; the final structured output still has to meet the completion schema and pass runner validation. Parse incrementally with maximum event size and explicit handling of truncated final records.

Ephemeral execution supports the fresh-context contract but cannot promise same-session recovery. An optional exec-resume path must bind to one saved session, provider, repository and task attempt. Never use the most recent unrelated session as a recovery shortcut. Cross-provider handoff should remain artifact-based rather than pretending a provider session can migrate.

Sandbox and approval policy are different: one constrains where effects can occur, the other decides when approval is requested. Compatibility tests must cover both and reject permissive fallback when a read-only reviewer cannot be established. Keep machine-readable errors out of the capability-failure ladder when the cause is permission or environment.

A stable prompt prefix is useful, but cache prices and retention are model-generation specific. Let the cost ledger consume reported usage and versioned billing evidence. Existing no-write-cost comments and estimates must be scoped to their historical source rather than copied into new economics.
